title: 上下文的语义线索
goal: 利用上下文的语义关系选择符合整段含义的词。

points.label: 识别上下文提供的语义线索
选择与整段含义一致的词

sources.title: 全国大学英语四、六级考试大纲（2016年修订版）

body.p: 词库里常有几个词性相同的词，放进空格都合语法。这时按意思选择。空格所在句和相邻句提供五种线索：同义复现、对比、因果、定义和举例。
例如 The path is steep. The climb is difficult. 两句里的 steep 和 difficult 都说明上坡不容易。找到线索后，再核对整段的意思。

cards.title: 同义复现和对比
rows: 同义复现
The path is steep. The climb is difficult.
steep 与 difficult 描述上坡不易。
同义复现
The room is silent. No one makes a sound.
silent 对应 no one makes a sound。
对比
The first box is heavy, but the second is light.
but 连接重量相反的描述。
对比
Unlike the dry field, the garden is wet.
Unlike 引出干湿对比。

cards.title: 因果关系
rows: 原因
The road was wet because it rained.
雨水解释路面潮湿的原因。
结果
The tank was empty, so workers filled it.
水箱空了促使工人注水。
原因
The gate stayed closed because repairs continued.
维修还在进行，所以大门关着。
结果
The bus was delayed. As a result, the class started late.
延误导致上课推迟。

cards.title: 定义和举例
rows: 定义
A volunteer is a person who offers help without pay.
后半句解释 volunteer 的含义。
定义
A schedule is a plan showing when activities occur.
后半句说明 schedule 的用途。
举例
The shop sells fruit, such as apples and pears.
apples 和 pears 是 fruit 的例子。
举例
Tools, including hammers and saws, were stored here.
hammers 和 saws 是 tools 的例子。

body.box:
The old room was noisy. After the machines were moved, it became _____. People could read without hearing them.
1. quiet
2. crowded
3. bright
4. narrow

body.p: 后句说人们读书时听不到机器声，quiet 与此对应，也和前句的 noisy 构成对比，即第一项。第三项 bright 也能描述房间，但前后句讲的是声音。

items.stem: The room was silent. No one made a _____.
items.why: silent 与 No one made a sound 同义复现。make a plan、make a mistake 也是搭配，但与前句的 silent 无关。

items.stem: Unlike the heavy box, the small bag was _____.
items.why: Unlike 表明重量对比；light 与 heavy 相对。

items.stem: Rain filled the tank, so it was no longer _____.
items.why: 雨水灌满水箱，所以水箱不再是空的。

items.stem: The basket contained fruit, including apples and _____.
items.why: including 引出 fruit 的例子；pears 与 apples 都是水果。

groups.text: A room beside the road was noisy. The school moved its reading group to a room at the back of the building. There, students could read without the sound of passing cars.

items.stem: The first room was _____ because of the road.
items.why: 原文直接说明 A room beside the road was noisy。

items.stem: The new room let students read without traffic _____.
items.why: 依据是 without the sound of passing cars，noise 与 sound 对应。

items.stem: The room was silent. Nobody made a _____.
items.why: silent 与 nobody made a sound 构成同义复现。

items.stem: The first road was wide, but the second was only two meters across and therefore _____.
items.why: but 引出宽度对比；narrow 与 wide 相对。

items.stem: The plants needed water, so the gardener _____ them.
items.why: 植物缺水促使园丁浇水，so 标示结果。

items.stem: A _____ is a plan that shows when activities will happen.
items.why: 后半句 a plan that shows when activities will happen 是定义，说的是活动的时间安排，即 schedule。record 记的是已经发生的事，与 will happen 不符。

items.stem: The hall was crowded before the concert. After everyone left, it was _____.
items.why: 依据是 After everyone left，人都离开后大厅就空了。empty 和前句的 crowded 构成对比。

items.stem: The road was closed for repairs. Drivers used another _____ to reach the station.
items.why: 道路关闭后司机改走另一条路线，route 符合前后句。

items.stem: The box contained tools, such as hammers and _____.
items.why: such as 引出工具的例子；saws 与 hammers 同属工具。

items.stem: The river was low after a dry month. Heavy rain later raised the water _____.
items.why: 前句说河水低，后句说大雨使水位上升。level 和前句的 low 相对应。
